symptom: The live last-minute vacation rail contains supplier-confirmed online-bookable offers, but does not present them as online-bookable and a matching vacation detail page has no usable path into booking.
expected_behavior: Last-known accepted online-booking capability remains visible during a transient refresh failure, online-capable last-minute offers are ordered and labeled accordingly, and a dated offer can continue to a live revalidated booking flow.
environment: VII production at https://vii.spaplus.co on release 530, inspected 2026-10-20.

steps: Open the home page and inspect the last-minute vacation rail.
Read /api/vii/home-deals?period=tomorrow&locale=he and select an offer whose onlineBooking field is true, such as site 1605.
Attempt to continue to booking and compare the visible controls with the live quote endpoints.
reproduction.evidence: Production returned 56 last-minute offers, including 18 with onlineBooking=true. The cache status was stale with checkedAt 2026-10-20T13:36:11.987Z. The detail confirmation text stated that the 1,400 ILS stay could continue online, but the rendered page exposed no booking link. POST /api/vii/stay-quote for site 1605 returned supplier_unavailable.

observations.observation: The accepted last-minute snapshot still contains 18 onlineBooking=true offers and valid positive room IDs.
Both server and client deliberately classify every stale home-deal snapshot as not online-bookable.
observations.evidence: app/lib/vacation-online-first.ts returns false when stale; app/components/home-live-deals.tsx rewrites dealAvailability.onlineBooking to false when cache.status is stale.

observations.observation: The vacation detail layout suppresses the entire booking aside and always removes the sticky booking destination for vacation pages.
observations.evidence: app/business/client-page.tsx uses activeWorld === vacation ? null for the booking aside and activeWorld === vacation ? undefined for DetailStickyDock.onlineHref.

observations.observation: The live supplier quote needed to authorize booking currently fails, and the bundled catalog summary does not carry verified room options for site 1605.
observations.evidence: POST /api/vii/stay-quote returned {error:supplier_unavailable}; /api/catalog?world=vacations&id=1605 returned source=bundled-fallback with no summary.roomOptions.

observations.observation: The scheduled design intends to refresh capabilities every ten minutes and near-date discovery every thirty minutes, but the accepted production snapshot remained over one hour old.
observations.evidence: worker/index.ts scheduled handler and the live checkedAt timestamp.

hypotheses.mechanism: There are no online-bookable last-minute offers.
hypotheses.prediction: The live home-deals payload contains no onlineBooking=true rows.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Inspect the exact production home-deals payload and count onlineBooking=true rows.
hypotheses.result: Rejected: 18 of 56 offers are marked onlineBooking=true, including sites 1605, 144, 2356 and 2210.

hypotheses.mechanism: The stale-cache safety rule erases accepted last-known online capability from ranking and card presentation.
hypotheses.prediction: A stale response still contains true flags, while the UI helper and card adapter force them to false.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Compare the live payload with isHomeDealOnlineEligible and dealAvailability.
hypotheses.result: Supported exactly: the payload contains true flags, but both helpers suppress them solely because status is stale.

hypotheses.mechanism: A detail-page rendering regression removes the booking entry point even when dated online evidence exists.
hypotheses.prediction: The live page confirms the deal but renders no booking CTA, and the source contains a vacation-specific null branch.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Open a dated online offer, inventory booking controls, and inspect the shared detail layout condition.
hypotheses.result: Supported: the confirmation says the stay can continue online, but no booking CTA is present; the vacation branch explicitly renders null.

hypotheses.mechanism: Only presentation is broken; the live booking authorization path is healthy.
hypotheses.prediction: The live stay-quote returns an available online quote and a verified room ID.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: POST the exact site, dates and party to /api/vii/stay-quote.
hypotheses.result: Rejected: the endpoint returned supplier_unavailable, so the live authorization path is also unhealthy.

fix.change: Not implemented in this diagnostic turn. Required repair is to preserve accepted last-known capability during refresh failure, restore a vacation booking entry point, and make the live quote and verified room mapping succeed before allowing final booking submission.
fix.evidence: No production mutation or release was authorized by the current diagnostic request.
